verdict.rationale: Pulley is an equity and cap-table management SaaS. Such a platform could plausibly offer workflow automations with version history and rollback, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents user-defined automations, let alone versioning, review, or rollback of them. Vesting email alerts and cap table history or as-of-date downloads are adjacent features, not automation version control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
